title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoint
description: Introduces a `/health` route that returns a simple JSON status and implements graceful shutdown handling for SIGINT/SIGTERM. This ensures the framework can be safely stopped in production environments and provides an easy liveness probe for orchestrators.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM signal and verify server.close is called, pending connections are allowed to finish, and process exits with code 0
acceptance:
- `/health` endpoint responds with HTTP 200 and body {"status":"ok"} within 50 ms.
- When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the server stops accepting new connections, waits up to 5 seconds for active requests to complete, then exits with code 0.
- No unhandled promise rejections or errors are logged during shutdown.
- All existing tests continue to pass.
reason: Production deployments need reliable liveness checks and clean termination to avoid dropped requests and resource leaks. Adding this built‑in capability removes the need for custom shutdown code in each app, improving stability and observability.
